title: The Charter Skipper (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character portrait unhurried Perth boats
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He used to nail down roofs in the Western Australian heat
Now he reads the swell before the harbour and the fleet
The same hands that drove the nails now turn the wheel
The charter skipper knows the difference in the feel

[Pre-Chorus]
From thirty feet above a house to thirty feet above the sea
Pete reckoned one was like the other — turns out both are free

[Chorus]
The charter skipper on the morning run
Reads the weather and the water and the angle of the sun
The charter skipper used to be up on the tiles
Now he's out past Rottnest doing nautical miles
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The clients come aboard and he gives them the full brief
Life jackets and the exit and the fishing at the reef
He knows the fish are where the birds are — that's the rule
The charter skipper learned that in a completely different school

[Bridge]
My brother Pete became the skipper sometime in his fifties
Which means he learned the whole thing while the rest of us were iffy
About our plans — he went and got his ticket and his boat
And put Pelican Charters on the water and afloat

[Outro]
Charter skipper knows the sea now… Pete knows the sea…
That's my boy
